run.requirements: Yield Banks OpenSea payout, royalty, and allocation remediation

summary.building: Safe SeaDrop primary payout and multi-asset Seaport royalty ingress for Yield Banks
summary.topRisk: The existing general SinjohFeeRouter adds a fixed fee and breaks exact mint-receipt accounting
summary.mustDecideFirst: Declare the equity custody and income model in the signed collection release manifest
summary.watchOutFor: ERC-2981 does not enforce secondary earnings

risks.title: Incompatible payout intermediary
risks.detail: A native-rejecting or fee-charging intermediary breaks exact payout accounting.

risks.title: Native royalty recipient rejection
risks.detail: Native-fee orders cannot pay a receiver that rejects ETH.

risks.title: Marketplace configuration drift
risks.detail: OpenSea fee configuration can differ from the onchain signal.

risks.title: Hard-coded economic policy
risks.detail: A source constant cannot represent per-collection royalties.

risks.title: Custom behavior around standard primitives
risks.detail: Protocol-specific routing and proof transfer logic needs direct tests.

preCodingDecisions.title: Core asset custody
preCodingDecisions.detail: Declare onchain tokenized-equity custody or an offchain custody receipt, plus income behavior and an HTTPS disclosure, in the release manifest.

preCodingDecisions.title: Primary routing boundary
preCodingDecisions.detail: Use the proceeds vault as the collection-specific Sinjoh primary fee router with no additional general-router fee.

requirementsCorrections.detail: The existing general SinjohFeeRouter is not compatible with exact SeaDrop receipt accounting.
Royalty routes must be timelock-bound and codehash-pinned; synchronization must be allocation-operator-only with fresh amount-specific execution data.
The secondary royalty basis points must be configured per collection.
